prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 6 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1460; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and reported neck pain, stiffness, and intermittent headaches described as tension-type in quality. Examination revealed limited cervical range of motion, particularly with rotation to the left, along with paraspinal muscle tenderness and no focal neurological deficits. Cervical strain was diagnosed. Neurological screening, including reflexes, sensation, and grip strength, remained within normal limits throughout care.

Treatment over six visits consisted of manual therapy, guided therapeutic exercise for cervical stabilization, and home exercise instruction with postural education. The patient was also advised on activity modification and the appropriate use of over-the-counter analgesics. Pain scores and range of motion improved steadily across visits, and headache frequency decreased.

At the most recent visit, the patient reported substantial improvement with residual mild stiffness after prolonged sitting. Range of motion was near baseline and the patient demonstrated good understanding of the self-management program. Discharge from active care is recommended with instructions to continue the home exercise program and return if symptoms worsen or new neurological symptoms develop.
